_note: MuSiQue variant of configs/decomposer.json for components/decomposer/run_decomposer.py (issue #12). Same runner, same per-model configs; only the question source, the hop depths and the condition block differ. The MetaQA defaults in configs/decomposer.json are untouched. Select a condition with --condition; the three conditions share seed, model folder (--model) and decoding settings, so the only difference between them is what the prompt says about the hop count and whether generation is stopped at a step-line budget.
_unguided_prompt_note: A model folder with no 'unguided_prompt_file' falls back to its guided prompt and fills {hop_count} with unguided_hop_placeholder, so an 'unguided' run would still show 'Hop count: Unknown' under a rule saying the step count must equal the hop count. That is neither arm. With this flag set, run_decomposer.py refuses such a run instead. Of the current model folders, mistral_7b_instruct and qwen3_5_9b ship an unguided prompt; qwen2_5_3b and phi_4_mini_instruct do not and cannot run the unguided arms. configs/decomposer.json does not set this flag, so the MetaQA path is unchanged.
_eval_set_note: questions_template_key resolves to the pinned v1 MuSiQue evaluation set of ADR 0007: musique/dev_data/musique_ans_v1.0_dev_sample_{hop}_hop_200.jsonl for hop in 2/3/4, 200 rows each, 600 total. hops must stay [2, 3, 4] and sample_size null for a run to be on that set; all three conditions read exactly these files, which is what makes them comparable.

unguided._note: No hop count in the prompt: the model decides how many steps to emit.

oracle_guided._note: Gold hop count injected into the prompt via the existing guided mechanism (the {hop_count} placeholder, or the guided prompt file when the model folder has one). The hop count comes from the evaluation file the question was read from.

unguided_capped._note: No hop count in the prompt, but generation stops once 8 newline-delimited step lines have been produced (a transformers StoppingCriteria, not post-hoc truncation). The supervisor's example in the 2026-08-12 meeting used a cap of 6; 8 is Jahid's plan default and is the value set here - see docs/meetings/2026-08-12-supervisor-meeting-transcript-crosscheck.md.

_conditions_note: A condition may set only 'guided' and 'stop_after_step_lines' (plus '_note'). Decoding, model and seed are deliberately NOT per-condition: run_decomposer.py rejects any other key so the three arms cannot drift apart.
_generation_overrides_note: Applied identically to every condition, on top of the per-model generation block, so decoding is the same in all three arms. max_new_tokens is the hard token cap that bounds a runaway generation in the uncapped arms too; 256 is a plumbing default carried over from the largest per-model value in components/decomposer/models/*/config.json (qwen3_5_9b) and is Jahid's to confirm before the experiment runs - it was not measured.
_retrieval_note: input null means the questions come from questions_template_key. The few-shot retrieval the three arms share is an UPSTREAM artifact, not something this config can rebuild: issue #12 pins it to bi-encoder top-20 reranked by the cross-encoder to top-5, typed masking, pool size 2000 - the pool_sweep cell with similarity_top_k 20, rerank_k 5, retrieval_mode typed, imbalanced pool 2000 (configs/pool_sweep.json). Pass that cell's top-5 JSONL as --retrieval-input, the SAME file for all three conditions. Note the trade-off: with --retrieval-input the questions come from the retrieval file rather than questions_template_key, so that file must have been built over the pinned 600 (ADR 0007) or the arms are not on the pinned set - check rows_loaded_per_hop in the run's metrics.json. With no --retrieval-input, a model folder with few_shot.enabled=true falls back to the MetaQA pool in few_shot_pool_key, which is not a MuSiQue pool.
